text.tspan: Covers US 7.0.6 and 7.0.7. The PDF job flow and hidden questions (7.0.7) exist. The code has no fixed limit of 50 SIRs.
"(proposed)" = the step is not in the code today.
A Steward who sends the same request directly is refused the same way
[Each batch of SIRs (proposed, batch size not decided)]
The job only reads SIRs, so the stored reports stay unchanged (7.0.6 AT 4, 7.0.7 AT 3).
An Admin who did not create the job also gets 404.
Letting Admins read other users' jobs is proposed
Open questions: the cause of the 50 SIR limit (the time limit of after(), memory,
or the size of the request), and one PDF or a zip of several PDFs.
Decided in code: hidden fields are per question, with a toggle for each section.

svg.text: Per-SIR selection is only on /admin/sites/[id] (site mode)
Clear questions to hide, one by one or a whole section (US 7.0.7)
Questions come from getQuestionsOnline(). A section is turned off
only when all of its questions are cleared (selectedSections)
parseHiddenQuestionIds() drops ids that are not integers
Today fetchReportData loads all SIRs of the sites, then filters by selectedResponseIds
filterResponsesByOptions() removes answers of hiddenQuestionIds (7.0.7 AT 2)
Render pages. Same answers as the SIR page (7.0.6 AT 2)
Admin opens Recent Exports (PdfExportsDropdown) and sees Failed.
RLS returns the row only to the job creator (exists in local schema)
Export has each selected SIR (7.0.6 AT 1).
With no hidden questions it has the full SIR (7.0.7 AT 5)
US 7.0.6, 7.0.7: Export More Than 50 Site Inspection Reports / Hide Fields on a SIR Before Export
